body:
## Pull request overview

Updates unit tests to match the repo’s current Vitest DOM environment behavior and to avoid overly broad selectors that were triggering false failures.

**Changes:**
- Refines the DashboardRenderer design-mode test selector to ignore data-table ghost rows.
- Updates ReportViewer conditional-formatting color assertion to match happy-dom’s hex color serialization.

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 2 out of 2 changed files in this pull request and generated 1 comment.

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/plugin-dashboard/src/__tests__/DashboardRenderer.designMode.test.tsx | Narrows `.pointer-events-none` query to exclude ghost rows so the test only flags design-mode wrappers. |
| packages/plugin-report/src/__tests__/ReportViewer.test.tsx | Changes expected `backgroundColor` string from rgb to hex to match happy-dom output. |
